dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So, Nam, tell me about your goals. When did you decide to become a teacher?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈnɑːm, ˈtɛl miː əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈɡoʊlz. ˈwɛn dɪd juː dɪˈsaɪd tə bɪˈkʌm ə ˈtiːtʃər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In high school. I knew then that I would be a teacher one day, like my parents.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈhaɪ ˌskuːl. aɪ ˈnuː ˈðɛn ðæt aɪ wʊd bi ə ˈtiːtʃər ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ, ˈlaɪk maɪ ˈpɛrənts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, the weekend I taught at a village school last year. After that, I knew I would work with children.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðə ˈwiːkɛnd aɪ ˈtɔːt ət ə ˈvɪlɪdʒ ˌskuːl ˈlæst ˈjɪr. ˈæftər ˈðæt, aɪ ˈnuː aɪ wʊd ˈwɜːrk wɪð ˈtʃɪldrən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a clear vision. What's your long-term goal?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈklɪr ˈvɪʒən. ˈwʌts jʊr ˌlɔːŋ ˌtɜːrm ˈɡoʊl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: One day, I'd like to open a small English school for children who can't afford lessons.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ, aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈoʊpən ə ˈsmɔːl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈskuːl fər ˈtʃɪldrən huː ˈkænt əˈfɔːrd ˈlɛsənz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. And your short-term goals?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡreɪt ˈɡoʊl. ənd jʊr ˌʃɔːrt ˌtɜːrm ˈɡoʊlz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: First, a teaching certificate. I was going to start a course last month, but I didn't have enough money.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɜːrst, ə ˈtiːtʃɪŋ sərˈtɪfɪkət. aɪ wʌz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈstɑːrt ə ˈkɔːrs ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, bʌt aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈhæv ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌni.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That happens. A goal like yours takes a lot of self-discipline.
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈhæpənz. ə ˈɡoʊl ˈlaɪk ˈjʊrz ˈteɪks ə ˈlɑːt əv ˌsɛlf ˈdɪsəplɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. I promised myself that I would save 2,000 baht every month.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. aɪ ˈprɑːmɪst maɪˈsɛlf ðæt aɪ wʊd ˈseɪv ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt ˈɛvri ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And have you managed to do it?
dialogue.reading: ənd hæv juː ˈmænɪdʒd tə ˈduː ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So far, yes! I knew it would be hard, but I'm doing it.
dialogue.reading: ˈsoʊ ˈfɑːr, ˈjɛs! aɪ ˈnuː ɪt wʊd bi ˈhɑːrd, bʌt aɪm ˈduːɪŋ ɪt.
